verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a collaborative SaaS and agent-orchestration platform like HumanLayer, but the evidence pack never documents an export feature, a bulk data download, or an account-exit path. Repository-local JSON workspace config and the option to run the stack on your own workstation hint that some data stays local. Neither shows that tasks, sessions, comments, or review history can be exported in open formats, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec that might enable programmatic extraction.
